description: Read forms and entries or submit entries to Wufoo.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Wufoo API key used as the HTTP Basic authentication username. In Form Manager, open More > API Information beside a form: https://app.wufoo.com/#/form-manager

extraFields.label: Subdomain
extraFields.description: Your Wufoo account subdomain from https://<subdomain>.wufoo.com. Admins can find it in Account Manager: https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/wufoo/account/account-manager/

actions.name: count_entries
actions.description: Count entries for a Wufoo form, optionally using entry filters.

formIdentifier.description: The permanent form hash or the form title slug used by Wufoo.

match.description: How multiple entry filters are grouped.

fieldId.description: The Wufoo field ID to filter, such as EntryId or Field105.

value.description: The value compared with the selected field.

filters.description: Entry filters applied in their listed order.

inputSchema.description: The form identifier and optional Wufoo entry filters.

count.description: The number of entries matching the request.

actions.name: get_form
actions.description: Retrieve one Wufoo form by its permanent hash or title slug.

formIdentifier.description: The permanent form hash or the form title slug used by Wufoo.

includeTodayCount.description: Whether the form should include its number of entries received today.

inputSchema.description: The form identifier and optional daily-count control.

form.description: A Wufoo resource whose fields depend on the account and form definition.

actions.name: list_entries
actions.description: List, filter, sort, and page entries for a Wufoo form.

formIdentifier.description: The permanent form hash or the form title slug used by Wufoo.

includeSystemFields.description: Whether Wufoo should include system metadata such as IP and payment status.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

sortFieldId.description: The Wufoo field ID used to sort entries.

sortDirection.description: The direction used to sort entries.

match.description: How multiple entry filters are grouped.

fieldId.description: The Wufoo field ID to filter, such as EntryId or Field105.

value.description: The value compared with the selected field.

filters.description: Entry filters applied in their listed order.

inputSchema.description: The form identifier and documented Wufoo entry query controls.

items.description: A Wufoo resource whose fields depend on the account and form definition.

actions.name: list_form_fields
actions.description: List the field definitions for a Wufoo form.

formIdentifier.description: The permanent form hash or the form title slug used by Wufoo.

includeSystemFields.description: Whether Wufoo should include additional system metadata fields.

inputSchema.description: The form identifier and field metadata controls.

items.description: A Wufoo resource whose fields depend on the account and form definition.

actions.name: list_forms
actions.description: List Wufoo forms available to the connected API key.

page.description: The one-based Wufoo result page number.

limit.description: The maximum number of forms to return.

includeTodayCount.description: Whether each form should include its number of entries received today.

inputSchema.description: Pagination and optional daily-count controls for listing forms.

items.description: A Wufoo resource whose fields depend on the account and form definition.

actions.name: submit_entry
actions.description: Submit JSON field values as a new entry for a Wufoo form.

formIdentifier.description: The permanent form hash or the form title slug used by Wufoo.

additionalProperties.description: The string value submitted for a Wufoo field.

fields.description: Values keyed by Wufoo field IDs such as Field1 or Field105.

inputSchema.description: The target form and its dynamic Wufoo field values.

anyOf.description: The new entry ID when submission succeeds.

entryId.description: The new entry ID when submission succeeds.

anyOf.description: The Wufoo API link for the new entry when available.

entryLink.description: The Wufoo API link for the new entry when available.

anyOf.description: The form redirect URL when configured.

redirectUrl.description: The form redirect URL when configured.

anyOf.description: The general submission error when validation fails.

errorText.description: The general submission error when validation fails.

fieldId.description: The Wufoo field ID that failed validation.

message.description: The validation message returned by Wufoo.

items.description: A field validation error returned by Wufoo.

fieldErrors.description: Field-specific validation errors returned by Wufoo.
